lines.t: Lost in the static of my own way Then your voice breaks through the hate
Thunder calling through a midnight storm You said, return my child, be reborn
Every star you set in flames, I see your design Even in my wandering, you call me mine
You're my melody, you're my flame in the shadow Your words cut deeper than a sorrow
Every road I take you make brand new Your trumpet called and I ran to you
You're the way, the truth, the breakthrough In a world so cold, you are my soul
Pull me closer, make my spirit whole Your words are fire in my chest
Your mercy's heartbeat never ends I searched the skies, I searched the ground
But only in your voice was I found
You're my melody, you're my flame in the shadow
Your words cut deeper than the sorrow
Every road I take you make brand new
Your trumpet called and I ran to you
You're the way, the truth, the breakthrough
Take me higher, Lord, into your light
Wash my sins in the edge of night
Your love's the trap that caught my fall Now I'm raining with you through it all
You're my melody, you're my flame in the shadow Your words cut deeper than the sorrow
Every road I take you make brand new You're truly called and I ran to you
You're the way, the truth, the breakthrough
